name: Dreamland Wanderer
source:
My name is □□□□□□ and I am a Wanderer.
I survived the end of the known humanity, and lived a boring life until I faced my deepest fear in a strange dream. I am now wandering in two different worlds, one as real as the other. Accompanied by people I thought I had lost, I spend my time rebuilding former relationships and moving toward a new goal.
Facing monsters, getting stronger, discovering unknown places and living special moments with beautiful girls... our story just began but I already know that it will be a hell of an adventure!

[From [url=https://shli.itch.io/dreamland-wanderer]itch.io[/url]]
